description: This file is a shell script designed to prepare a chroot environment for a project. It creates necessary directory structures, copies required binaries (notably busybox and git), sets up essential system files like passwd and group, and provides instructions for entering the chroot environment.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error and exits the script with a status code 1.

methods.name: xmkdir
methods.description: Creates directories in a loop, dies if unable to create any directory.
